draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to an unfiltered summarizer, across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 (the only cited passage from Varga & Sandoval) describes the filtering method but reports no hallucination-reduction figure, no 31% value, and no three-benchmark evaluation. The 31% and "three benchmarks" are not in the package. The methods summary credits "about 30%" but that is not attributed to a reported result in P1.
